```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(readr)
life_data <- read_csv("life_data.csv")|>
  janitor::clean_names()


```


```{r}

library(rnaturalearth)
library(countrycode)
library(sf)
behandlet <- life_data |>
  mutate(country = countrycode(country,
                               "country.name",
                               "iso3c")) 

kart <- rnaturalearth::ne_countries(scale = "medium", type = "countries") |>
  select(iso_a3)|>
  left_join(behandlet, by = join_by (iso_a3 == country))

p1 <- kart |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = bmi))


p1
```
